items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: You ain't got a Frenchman around there that I know of.

ctx.x: But they had been there for a while then. They were there when you were younger, too.

Oh, well, yeah. They had been there for years. Because it was well populated. That's all. Well, it's just the same thing as you take the French market. We call it the French market. You ain't got a Frenchman around there that I know of. All these Italians, you know? Yeah. They took over.
